source: Element84 Earth Search v1 STAC, collection sentinel-2-l2a; COGs from sentinel-cogs (us-west-2)

grid.note: width,height; bounds snapped outward to 60 m, aligned with native S2 grid

notes: Folder per acquisition date; where two platforms imaged the same date (S2A + S2C tandem, 2024-12-06 and 2024-12-16) the S2C acquisition is in <date>_S2C.
Reprocessed duplicates (same tile, identical sensing datetime) -> newest generation kept, others listed as superseded (not downloaded).
Dates with multiple datastrips per tile are mosaicked from all items (first valid pixel; SRC.tif records item index).
2025-09-24: only tile 11UQS in catalogue -> partial AOI coverage (local_valid_fraction ~0.47).
local_* fractions from SCL inside the lon/lat context box, as fractions of valid pixels: cloud=SCL 8,9,10; snow=11; shadow=3.
